items.title: Petition period opens for 3 independent dispute resolution entities seeking recertification - American Hospital Association
items.reason: This item directly addresses IDR entity recertification under the No Surprises Act implementation, which is a concrete regulatory process affecting the Independent Dispute Resolution system.
items.summary: The American Hospital Association reports that a petition period has opened for three independent dispute resolution entities seeking recertification under the No Surprises Act. IDR entities are central to the Act's framework for resolving out-of-network payment disputes, and recertification is a periodic requirement to maintain authorization to adjudicate these cases. Revenue-cycle teams rely on IDR processes to manage and appeal out-of-network claim determinations, making the status and capacity of certified IDR entities operationally significant.
